## What We Did 

Reviewed R basics including dplyr and tidycensus. 

## Key Concepts 

dplyr review: 
filter() -> picks rows
select() -> picks columns 
mutate() -> adds a new computed column 
arrange() -> change order of rows (asc, desc, etc.)
group_by() + summarize () -> many rows become few

tidycensus review: 
load_variables() -> loading census variable identifiers

GEOID -- stored as a string: 
- first 2 # = state
- second 2 # = county
- final digits are scale = tract, block group

data <- get_acs (geography = "county", 
                variables = c("variable", "variable"), 
                state = "PA", 
                year = 2023, 
                survey = "acs5", 
                output = "wide")
                
generally want data in wide format
